name: Ember-Touched
desc: You have resistance to fire damage of 5 or less per instance. You suffer no ill effects from non-extreme hot environments.

name: Warm-Blooded
desc: You can ignite a small flame (candle, tinder, torch) at will, no action required.

name: Kindling Strike
desc: When you land a weapon attack, once per turn you may deal +1 fire damage. On a critical hit, the target catches fire for 1d4 fire damage at the start of its next turn (DC 10 DEX to negate).

name: Tide-Sensed
desc: You can hold your breath for 10 minutes. Your swim speed equals your walking speed.

name: Cold-Warded
desc: You have resistance to cold damage of 5 or less per instance. Non-extreme cold environments do not affect you.

name: Acid-Proof Skin
desc: You have resistance to acid damage of 5 or less per instance. Your gear is unaffected by minor acid exposure.

name: Flowing Form
desc: You cannot be knocked prone while you have at least 5 ft. of movement remaining, and you have advantage on saves against being restrained or grappled.

name: Stone-Skinned
desc: When you take bludgeoning damage from a nonmagical source, reduce it by 1 (minimum 1).

name: Sure-Footed
desc: Difficult terrain caused by rock, gravel, or uneven ground does not slow you. +1 to saves against being knocked prone.

name: Deep-Rooted
desc: You have advantage on saves against being pushed or pulled by effects, provided you are on stable ground.

name: Stone-Cunning
desc: You have proficiency (or expertise if already proficient) on History checks about stonework, ruins, and underground structures. You can sense the direction of true north while underground.

name: Light-Step
desc: +5 ft. walking speed. Reduce falling damage by 5.

name: Shock-Warded
desc: You have resistance to lightning damage of 5 or less per instance.

name: Thunder-Warded
desc: You have resistance to thunder damage of 5 or less per instance. You are not deafened by non-magical loud sounds.

name: Wind-Read
desc: You always know which direction is downwind. You can whisper at normal volume and be heard clearly up to 30 ft. if the wind carries your voice.

name: Haloed
desc: You emit dim light in a 5 ft. radius at will (no action). It can be any color; you may suppress or resume it.

name: Light-Warded
desc: You have resistance to radiant damage of 5 or less per instance. Bright light does not blind or dazzle you.

name: Undead's Bane
desc: Your weapon attacks deal +1 radiant damage against undead and fiends. You have advantage on the first attack roll against an undead creature you can see.

name: Death-Marked
desc: You have resistance to necrotic damage of 5 or less per instance. You have advantage on death saving throws.

name: Grave-Touched
desc: Undead of CR 1/4 or lower ignore you unless you attack them. You can identify a corpse's cause of death with a 1-minute examination.

name: Soul-Sight
desc: You always know if a creature you can see is undead, and you can sense any undead creature within 30 ft. even through walls (direction and rough distance only).

name: Force-Warded
desc: You have resistance to force damage of 5 or less per instance.

name: Arcane-Touched
desc: +3 max MP (one-time). If you had no MP pool, you now have one starting at 3.

name: Spell-Reader
desc: You have advantage on Arcana checks to identify a spell as it is being cast.

name: Null-Field
desc: You have advantage on saving throws against spells of 3rd level or lower.

name: Mind-Warded
desc: You have resistance to psychic damage of 5 or less per instance. +1 to WIS saves against being charmed.

name: Still Mind
desc: You have advantage on saves against being frightened.

name: Reader of Faces
desc: +1 to Insight checks. When a creature within 30 ft. lies to you and you succeed on the Insight check, you also learn one true thing they meant to hide (DM's choice, single sentence).

name: Poison-Warded
desc: You have resistance to poison damage of 5 or less per instance. +1 to saves against the poisoned condition.

name: Iron Gut
desc: You are immune to sickness from spoiled food, minor toxins, and mundane alcohol. Advantage on saves against ingested poisons.

name: Venom-Scribe
desc: You have proficiency with the poisoner's kit, or expertise if already proficient. You can identify any poison you touch or taste (safely) within 1 minute.

name: Tough Hide
desc: +2 max HP (one-time).

name: Hard Knuckles
desc: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage (instead of 1) and count as a light weapon for finesse-like calculation.

name: Iron Grip
desc: You cannot be disarmed by any effect that allows a save. +1 to Athletics checks made to grapple or shove.

name: Weapon-Kin
desc: Choose one weapon at slotting. You gain +1 to attack rolls with that specific weapon (or type, at DM discretion).

name: Ember-Flick
desc: prof bonus/short rest (action): a creature within 30 ft. makes a DEX save (DC 8+prof+casting mod) or takes 1d6 fire damage.

name: Hearth-Ward
desc: 1/short rest (reaction to taking cold or fire damage): reduce the damage by 1d8. If the damage type was cold, gain temp HP equal to the amount reduced.

name: Tide's Mercy
desc: prof bonus/long rest (action): touch a creature; it regains 1d8 HP.

name: Frost Grip
desc: 1/short rest (bonus action): a creature within 30 ft. makes a CON save; on failure it takes 1d6 cold damage and its speed drops by 10 ft. until the end of your next turn.

name: Stone-Set
desc: prof bonus/long rest (bonus action): until the start of your next turn, you cannot be moved and gain +2 AC, but your speed becomes 0.

name: Shatter-Ground
desc: 1/short rest (action): creatures in a 10-ft. cone make a DEX save or take 1d8 bludgeoning damage and are pushed 5 ft. The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain.

name: Quickstep
desc: prof bonus/long rest (bonus action): teleport up to 15 ft. to a space you can see.

name: Thunder-Call
desc: 1/short rest (action): a 15 ft. cone; creatures make a CON save or take 1d6 thunder damage and are pushed 5 ft.

name: Shock-Strike
desc: 1/short rest (reaction on hit with a weapon attack): the attack deals +1d6 lightning damage and jumps to one other creature within 10 ft. of the target for the same lightning damage.

name: Light-Lash
desc: prof bonus/short rest (action): a creature within 30 ft. makes a DEX save or takes 1d6 radiant damage. On a fail against undead or fiends, deal 1d8 instead.

name: Dawn-Touch
desc: 1/long rest (action): touch a creature; it regains 2d4 HP and one condition ends (blinded, deafened, or paralyzed only).

name: Wither-Touch
desc: prof bonus/short rest (action): touch attack against a creature within 5 ft.; on hit, it takes 1d6 necrotic damage and you gain temp HP equal to the amount dealt.

name: Death-Whisper
desc: 1/long rest (action): question a corpse dead less than 1 hour; it answers one question truthfully if it can.

name: Arcane Bolt
desc: prof bonus/short rest (action): a creature within 60 ft. must be hit by a spell attack (your best casting mod); on hit, deals 1d8 force damage. Ignores half and three-quarters cover.

name: Null Pulse
desc: 1/short rest (reaction to a spell of 2nd level or lower being cast within 30 ft.): the caster makes a CHA save or the spell fails and the slot/MP is expended.

name: Mind-Prick
desc: prof bonus/short rest (action): a creature within 30 ft. makes an INT save or takes 1d6 psychic damage and cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.

name: Thought-Shove
desc: 1/long rest (action): a creature within 30 ft. that can hear and understand you makes a WIS save; on fail, it obeys one simple, non-suicidal command for 1 round.

name: Venom-Touch
desc: prof bonus/short rest (bonus action): the next weapon attack you hit before end of turn deals +1d6 poison damage and the target must make a CON save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn.

name: Purge
desc: 1/long rest (action): touch a creature; end the poisoned condition on it, or grant it advantage on its next save against poison within 1 minute.

name: Steadying Stance
desc: prof bonus/short rest (bonus action): gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn. If you did not move this turn, gain temp HP equal to your prof bonus.

name: Hard Swing
desc: 1/short rest (bonus action after a weapon hit): the hit deals +1d8 damage of the weapon's type.

name: Drifting Particles
desc: Small particles drift around you at all times. In stillness they hang like dust motes; in motion they swirl and trail. Cosmetic.

name: Faint Glow
desc: Your skin bears a soft glow in dim light and darkness. It is stronger where blood runs closest — throat, wrists, temples. Cosmetic.

name: Lit Eyes
desc: Your eyes glow subtly in dim light and darkness. In bright light they simply appear vividly colored. Cosmetic.

name: Signed Steps
desc: Where you walk, faint traces linger for a moment before fading. Cosmetic. A skilled tracker might identify you by them.

name: Physical Mark
desc: A mark appears somewhere on your body — a scar, a birthmark, a tattoo-like sigil. It cannot be covered by illusion. Cosmetic.

name: Halo
desc: A faint ring hangs behind your head, visible only from certain angles or in reflections. Cosmetic.

name: Untouched Hair
desc: Your hair moves as though by breath and wind that isn't there, and stays perfectly still when wind should move it. Cosmetic.

name: Uncanny Reflection
desc: Your reflection sometimes lags, moves independently for a fraction of a second, or shows something slightly different from you. Never long enough to matter. Cosmetic.

name: Signature Scent
desc: You carry a faint, distinctive scent that lingers where you have been for about an hour after you leave. Cosmetic.

name: Drifting Embers
desc: Embers drift around you when you are stirred, angered, or exert yourself. Cosmetic.

name: Ripplekin
desc: Water and other liquids you touch ripple outward on contact. Plants bearing moisture bend gently toward you. Cosmetic.

name: Stone-Step
desc: Stone or bare earth beneath your feet emits faint dust when you step firmly, though no debris rises. Cosmetic.

name: Wind-Kin
desc: A soft breeze moves your hair and clothing at all times, even indoors and underground. Cosmetic.

name: Dawn-Lit
desc: A gentle radiance rests on your skin in low light. NPCs of religious bent may treat you with curiosity or reverence. Cosmetic.

name: Dimming Presence
desc: Small light sources near you (candles, torches) flicker or dim in your presence. Small creatures avoid your gaze. Cosmetic.

name: Arcane Shimmer
desc: A faint arcane shimmer trails your fingertips when you gesture. Spellcasters recognize you as gifted. Cosmetic.

name: Thought-Print
desc: Those in a quiet room with you can occasionally sense your mood without explanation, but never your thoughts. Cosmetic.

name: Faint Taint
desc: Small flying pests avoid you and die if they touch you. Cut flowers wilt slightly in your presence over hours. Cosmetic.

name: Weighted Print
desc: Your footfalls sound slightly heavier than they should, in a way skilled ears can identify. Cosmetic.
